item.title: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield to likely miss 3 weeks with dislocated thumb
item.description: Mayfield was injured while scrambling and throwing an interception on a fourth-and-13 play in the fourth quarter of Sunday's game.
item.media:description: Baker Mayfield was injured after getting hit while throwing an interception on fourth down.

item.title: 49ers top Cardinals to reach 3-0, but lose Mike Evans, Trent Williams to injuries
item.description: Evans left with a rib injury and Trent Williams exited with a stinger in the 49ers' 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
item.media:description: Brock Purdy threw for 297 yards and four touchdowns to lead the 49ers to a 36-30 win over the Cardinals.

item.title: Mike Evans ruled out with rib injury, further decimating 49ers at receiver
item.description: Evans seemed to be in significant discomfort as he left the game in the second quarter.
item.media:description: Mike Evans was in a lot of discomfort as he left Sunday's game with a rib injury.

item.title: NFL experts' Week 3 takeaways: 49ers keep rolling, Chargers stumble and Drake Maye struggles
item.description: It’s no shock that the Dolphins and Titans are 0-3. It’s very shocking that the Chargers and the Texans are also winless.
item.media:description: Ladd McConkey and the Los Angeles Chargers had another win slip through their fingers.

item.title: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson ruled out after suffering ankle injury vs. Buccaneers
item.description: Jefferson played just six snaps for the Vikings, who were hoping to find some offensive momentum behind quarterback Kyler Murray.
item.media:description: Vikings receiver Justin Jefferson suffered an ankle injury in the first half of Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.
